macro.name: ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2
macro.collision: Model reads pre-write value at same edge; controller must stall same-address read/write until required committed value is visible

L2.valid_mapping: Scalar row[15:13] macro, row[12:3] word, row[2:0] lane; all 32 lane mask bits set only for selected FP32 lane
L2.line_assembly: 128B injector line requires four 256bit bank reads; finite four-cycle assembler, no fictional 1024bit macro read

gather.sector_write: Sector offset[1:0] selects one of four macros, line slot selects macro word. At most one accepted sector per macro per cycle; conflicts backpressure per-PC return queue
gather.completion: Four-sector bitmap plus retained generation/tag required before reading complete line; stalled output retains FIFO/credit

backend_queues.simultaneous_ports: Separate request and return 1R1W macros each sustain one enqueue and one dequeue per PC cycle; unallocated half of each macro is charged, not free port sharing
backend_queues.queue_credit: No dequeue into a blocked downstream landing FIFO; DRAM return scheduled only against reserved return credit

area.remaining_unpriced: 32-PC to 36-client/four-sector gather crossbar, landing FIFO controls, write-ACK buffering and RF/vector/TP consumer service; no build admission until these are model composed

finite_services.remaining: Sector conflicts and gather ready stalls consume actual cycles; existing service ceiling is only an upper bound. Crossbar lane policy, FIFO depth and arbitration latency must be priced before RTL
